options.text: Mildly. It didn't bother me much
Moderately. It was very unpleasant but I could stand it
Severely. I could barely stand it

ranges.label: A score of 21 or below indicates a minimal level of anxiety.
A score of 22 to 35 indicates a moderate level of anxiety.
A score above 36 (with a maximum of 63) indicates a very high level of anxiety.
